NEW YORK


, Nov. 16, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- SiteOne Landscape Supply Inc. (NYSE: SITE) will replace Integer Holdings Corp. (NYSE: ITGR) in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Thursday, November 19. S&P 500 constituent KKR & Co Inc. (NYSE: KKR) is acquiring Integer Holdings in a deal expected to close soon, pending final closing conditions.
